# AML-Filter

> AML-Filter is a zero-server, open-source tool for screening names against signed public sanctions lists entirely in a web browser.

AML-Filter executes matching and local KYC case review inside the browser tab via WebAssembly and OPFS SQLite. Zero typed names or customer records leave the device (`connect-src 'self'`). It is MIT-licensed open-source software, not legal advice and not a compliance product; do not use it to satisfy legal or regulatory obligations.

## Canonical URLs

- [AML-Filter](https://aml-filter.com/): Product overview, live list counts, and architecture.
- [Screen a name](https://aml-filter.com/screen): Interactive zero-upload sanctions screener (US OFAC SDN, EU, UN, UK OFSI).
- [OFAC SDN Check](https://aml-filter.com/ofac-check/): Free in-browser U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN screening guide.
- [Sanctions Screening](https://aml-filter.com/sanctions-screening/): Local-first KYC screening workflow for small businesses.
- [Screening Without Uploading Data](https://aml-filter.com/sanctions-screening-without-uploading-data/): Zero-egress privacy architecture and GDPR data-minimisation notes.
- [EU, UN & UK Sanctions Lists](https://aml-filter.com/eu-sanctions-list/): Consolidated list coverage across OFAC SDN, EU, UN Security Council, and UK OFSI.
- [Trust & Verification](https://aml-filter.com/trust/): Cryptographic bundle verification, live version inspection, and key-rotation history.

## Data Freshness & Cryptographic Verification

- Signed pointer: `https://aml-filter.com/bundle/origin/latest` publishes `manifest_hash`, watchlist `version`, monotonic anti-rollback `sequence`, and Ed25519 `signature`.
- Trust root: 32-byte Ed25519 key pinned same-origin at `https://aml-filter.com/public.key` (matches `frontend/app/public/public.key` in Git).
- Fail-closed integrity: every manifest and Gear-CDC chunk is SHA-256 content-addressed; bad signatures, altered chunks, or rollback attempts are rejected before SQLite opens.
